neural_eval_cache.key: position hash from ComputeEvalPositionHash; locked source explicitly notes repetitions/history are currently ignored
semantic_read: MemCacheComputation::AddInput returns FETCHED_IMMEDIATELY on cache hit and copies cached q/d/m/p into the requested EvalResult
MemCache::GetCachedEvaluation returns cached q/d/m/p when the key/policy-shape check passes

search_tree_state.semantic_role: Search selection and backup consume accumulated node/edge statistics across playouts.
search_tree_state.nonidentity: Persistent tree/DAG state is not an alpha-beta transposition-table read merely because it persists and can encode transpositions.

separation_principle: NEURAL_EVAL_CACHE and SEARCH_TREE_STATE are distinct causal channels. P20 does not aggregate them into one intervention.
prohibited_shortcuts: equate NN cache hit with Stockfish qsearch/main TT hit by name similarity
clear the entire tree and call that semantic-read removal without a sham/noninterference construction
disable neural caching and attribute all effects to persistent search memory without separating recomputation cost/timing from semantic reuse
intervene jointly on DAG identity, node statistics and NN cache and report one mechanism

neural_eval_cache_read.preferred_intervention: On a cache hit, force semantic miss/recompute while preserving the query, legal-move payload, underlying network, and cache write opportunity.
required_controls: MASK hit must be observationally equivalent to an independently implemented semantic-cache-bypass path
separate timing/recomputation effect from returned semantic payload

tree_or_dag_state_read.preferred_intervention: Constitute a narrowly defined state-consumption operator such as selected use of prior N/Q/D/M/P or transposed-node reuse, rather than deleting the whole tree.
required_controls: enumerate all downstream consumers of the selected state field
preserve tree topology when testing semantic payload removal unless topology itself is the declared variable
separate node identity/reuse from accumulated-statistic reuse
classic-tree and DAG implementations require independent admission before being pooled
